# dotnet-core-dev Copilot Skill

## Source
- **Author**: Custom Authored
- **Equivalent Extension**: **GitHub Copilot Modernization Extension for .NET** (or `@modernize-dotnet` agent)

## Setup & Usage
1. To configure GitHub Copilot with these instructions at the project level, append or place these instructions in your workspace's `.github/copilot-instructions.md` file.
2. In VS Code or Visual Studio, Copilot will read this file automatically to refine its C#/.NET suggestions.
3. If using `@modernize-dotnet`, refer to the official marketplace extension for system-wide modernization prompts.
